description: This line plot illustrates the ROUGE-1 scores achieved by four different model configurations—T5 + LoRA, MBart + LoRA, T5 + AdaLoRA, and MBart + AdaLoRA—across varying values of $\log r$. The x-axis, labeled "$\log r$", features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 9, with numeric tick marks placed at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "ROUGE-1", utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 35, with tick marks at intervals of 5. All four data series are represented by solid lines with circular markers. The red line, representing T5 + LoRA, exhibits a relatively steady trend, starting at approximately 23.2 at $x=0$ and ending at 24.2 at $x=9$, remaining relatively flat across the entire range. The purple line, representing MBart + LoRA, begins at 4.8 at $x=0$, experiences a decline to a low of 2.5 at $x=2$, sharply increases to 18.9 at $x=4$ and 22.5 at $x=5$, reaches a peak of 24.1 at $x=8$, and concludes at 23.3 at $x=9$. The green line, denoting T5 + AdaLoRA, starts at 23.2 at $x=0$, demonstrates a steady, gradual increase to 29.0 at $x=5$, and finishes at 30.1 at $x=9$. Finally, the orange line, corresponding to MBart + AdaLoRA, starts at 4.8 at $x=0$, shows a steep incline to 31.8 at $x=4$, and then gradually levels off to end at a peak value of 33.4 at $x=9$.
